paragraphs: Los Angeles Dodgers won. Leo's model favored the other side.

Yoshinobu Yamamoto (No clear pitching-plan edge), the starter Leo's pitcher score favored, actually outpitched Chris Sale: 7.0 IP, 1 ER (1.29 ERA) against 5.0 IP, 3 ER (5.40 ERA). The edge held up.
The Los Angeles Dodgers bullpen was not flagged pregame, but it had a night worth noting: 0 earned runs allowed over 2.0 relief innings (0.00 ERA) — quietly better than the pregame read implied.

The Atlanta Braves bullpen was flagged as elevated risk pregame (Tired). In relief it actually allowed 0 earned runs over 4.0 innings (0.00 ERA) — the risk read did not show up on the scoreboard tonight.
Los Angeles Dodgers scored 3, 1.8 fewer than the 4.8 pregame projection.
Atlanta Braves scored 1, 1.9 fewer than the 2.9 pregame projection.
Likely driver: Chris Sale, the pick's own starter, was rocked for a 5.40 ERA, and the opposing starter (1.29 ERA) was sharp when the read expected an edge the other way.
